claim_scope: Sensitivity of model configurations to country framing and instruction wording on one designed adult roster, not national behavior or population realism.
candidate_language: Unchanged English field names and persona values
randomization: Independent SHA256-derived streams for actor order, choice counts and candidate display order. Display order is shuffled once per repetition and filtered to eligible candidates, shared across models and conditions. No claim of deterministic API sampling.
choice_policy: Local/sequential and iterative initialization retain floor(clamp(Exponential(scale=5),1,20)); this is a nomination quota, not fixed final degree. Iterative retains three add/drop rounds. First three sequential decisions retain local initialization.
global_policy: Free edge count. Explicit complete-network rather than disjoint-pair instructions; zero or multiple friends and disconnected components allowed. NONE explicitly encodes an empty graph. No connectivity or nonzero-edge acceptance requirement.
retry_policy: At most three attempts; singular/plural cardinality instructions. Global repair preserves the first nonempty recoverable valid edge set; it may not silently delete or invent valid ties. Empty nonresponses are distinct from explicit NONE. All failed attempts must remain accounted for by any future paid runner.
outcome_notes: Constrained-method density/connectivity are diagnostics. RQ2 uses attribute-specific reference comparisons, not causal dominance or ranking age against categorical scores. Degree-one share is continuous; no post-hoc matching-like threshold is treated as confirmed bimodality.
control_notes: Repeated G(n,m) and degree-preserving controls; deterministic demographic-similarity reference once. Retain failed swap attempts; completion does not prove mixing. Reference percentiles are not confidence intervals for treatment effects.

inference.primary_families: For each method and RQ1/RQ4 separately: 4 models x 3 baseline contrasts x 2 primary outcomes, 24 hypotheses, Holm within that declared family. RQ3 per method: 6 model pairs x 7 settings x 2 primary outcomes, 84 hypotheses. This is family-specific, not study-wide FWER control.
inference.rq2: Descriptive exploratory attribute-specific control adjustment unless a separate confirmatory family is approved before collection.
inference.analysis_unit: Network generation; decisions, nodes, edges and null graphs are not independent treatment repetitions.
inference.pairing: Require recorded common randomization schedules; seed labels alone do not demonstrate correlation or justify paired precision claims. Report distributions and model-by-condition heterogeneity before pooling.
inference.sample_size_rule: Choose targets from meaningful effects/precision and variance sensitivity, not favorable pilot significance. Any adaptive collection needs a predeclared valid rule or independent confirmation sample.
inference.null_claims: Report intervals and detectable effects; lack of significance does not prove equivalence. Equivalence requires an approved margin and valid interval/test.
inference.calibration_reuse: No automatic pooling of V5 or revised exploratory calibration into confirmatory results. Reuse needs an explicitly justified, predeclared procedure.

probe_scope.authorization_scope: 72 first replies only, separate hash-bound probe authorization required; no recalibration or main collection

human_review.limitation: No independent human bilingual validation. User accepts this limitation; it is not evidence of equivalent translations.

translation_status: AI-authored revision candidate; human review unavailable and explicitly waived by owner. Not a second independent translation. Probe results, if collected, are separate evidence.
